steps.name: Project navigation
steps.goal: Reach the demo Home screen with its project rail. If a conversation is open, tap Back at the top left to return to Home. If the system Home screen is visible, tap the omg app icon. If an AI data consent screen appears, accept it for this isolated demo fixture. Do not type into Message or open a conversation.
steps.done: The normal project navigation and composer are visible.

steps.name: Empty unassigned chats
steps.goal: Tap ONLY the element labelled Chats without a project. It is the first chip in the top project rail below Welcome. Do not tap add or Attach a file in the bottom composer. If a menu is open, close it first.
steps.done: The plus tab is selected and the session list is blank. Do not focus the composer yet.
forbid: What would you like to create

steps.name: Starter cards with details
steps.goal: Tap the message composer to focus it and show the keyboard. If iOS shows its slide-to-type tutorial, tap Continue to dismiss that tutorial.
steps.done: The starter cards have moderate corners, an icon, and a short description above the composer. The keyboard remains visible. The separate starter-row-scroll flow checks both horizontal directions.
expect: Build a mobile or web app

steps.name: Create a chat
steps.goal: Tap Start website once. Wait for the normal conversation screen.
steps.done: The conversation shows the starter prompt and the fixture reply. No mode toggle is present.
expect: What would you like your website to do?

steps.name: Unassigned session row
steps.goal: Use the back button to return to Home. Stay on the plus tab.
steps.done: The new chat appears as a normal session row in the unassigned list.

steps.name: Project separation
steps.goal: Tap api-gateway folder in the project navigation.
steps.done: The existing project conversations return and the unassigned chat is excluded.
